mapping_json.fidelity_notes: DUAL-IDENTITY kit: (1) totem-proxy delivery (PROXY_ASCENSION, Hierophant totem archetype) + (2) the life-cost-as-weapon warp where the spell's self-damage is OUTSOURCED to the totems. Element chaos -> shadow (crosswalk s1). The payload is a HIT scaled off life+ES, not a DoT, so ailments empty (probe control centrality=none; the 'poison/wither' probe tags are minor riders, not the identity). hp_cost_scale=0.3 (engine LOCKED cap) + reservation_resource=hp captures the life-price economy, but the SIGNATURE is that the totem, not the player, pays it -- the engine has no 'redirect self-damage-cost to a proxy entity' primitive, so the life-cost lands on the chassis and the OUTSOURCING is noted/docketed. SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY is the life-trade T4 door; PROXY_ASCENSION the totem door. Soul Mantle (totems take your ailments) + Self-Flagellation (self-curse-for-damage) is a secondary economy loop. Dominant 3-sec loop = totems auto-casting; the totem-proxy delivery leads per s7.2.

spine.mech_note: Forbidden Rite: chaos spell that costs life to cast (in addition to mana), dealing chaos damage plus launching seeking chaos projectiles that home on enemies. The self-damage cost makes the player pay HP per cast, creating a life-floor pressure. Totem delivery (Spellslinger or FR Totem) makes the TOTEM pay the blood price instead — totems have no life penalty feedback to the player. CI (Chaos Inoculation) makes chaos damage bypass ES irrelevant (CI sets life to 1 but ES absorbs all chaos from other sources). Blood Magic keystone enables life-paying builds that remove mana as a constraint. Emerged as a legitimate league-start skill in 3.15-3.17 for Solo Self-Found (SSF) due to requiring zero specific unique items. Strong chaos-damage ceiling; the self-damage cost is the tuning knob, not an intrinsic flaw.
